audit_scope: P0-PG-01 only: schema-to-code consistency audit for Postgres/Supabase shadow deployment. NOT P0-PG-02 (drift fix), NOT P0-PG-03 (smoke), NOT P0-PG-04/05 (CI), NOT P0-PG-06 (docs).
recommended_next_stage_rationale: This audit found 8 P0 schema/code/deployment blockers (see 02_SCHEMA_CODE_DRIFT_AUDIT.md §5 and 03_DEPLOYMENT_RUNNABILITY_AUDIT.md §4). All blockers are fixable in a dedicated P0-PG-02 stage. None of the blockers should be addressed in this audit stage. P0-PG-02 should: (a) add the 3 missing-table migrations (000011_shadow_decision_trace.sql, 000013_shadow_position_marks.sql, 000014_shadow_exit_tables.sql), (b) consolidate the 2 in-Go CREATE TABLE statements (decision_trace.go, position_mark.go) into migrations, (c) align chain column types (INT vs TEXT) across all tables, (d) add lpbot-shadow.service EnvironmentFile=.env.postgres, (e) document config.shadow.toml + lpbot-shadow.service + apply_postgres_migrations.sh chain.

top_10_blockers.title: Missing migration: shadow_decision_trace
top_10_blockers.impact: If a fresh deploy runs apply_postgres_migrations.sh and then lpbot-shadow, the live schema guard at main.go:821 will fail. The runtime fallback ensureShadowDecisionTraceTable is a workaround that hides the gap.

top_10_blockers.title: Missing migration: shadow_position_marks
top_10_blockers.impact: Dashboard SELECT and canary_reconcile_mint DELETE will fail with 'relation does not exist' on fresh shadow deploy.

top_10_blockers.title: Missing migration: shadow_exit_decisions, shadow_exit_actions
files: cmd/lpbot/position_mark.go:147,185 (in-Go CREATE TABLE for shadow_exit_decisions, shadow_exit_actions)
top_10_blockers.impact: Same as BLK-PG-02 — runtime CREATE TABLE workaround hides the gap.

top_10_blockers.title: Migration file numbering gap: 000010 -> 000012 (no 000011)
top_10_blockers.impact: Indicates a missing migration was either deleted or never committed. Goose ordering depends on lexical order; the gap is suspicious and may indicate a lost file or rebased-out migration.
top_10_blockers.fix_in: P0-PG-02 (investigate git log; if migration was lost, re-create)

top_10_blockers.title: Chain column type inconsistency across tables (TEXT vs INTEGER)
files: migrations/postgres/000001_init_schema.sql (positions.chain INTEGER, pools.chain INTEGER, pnl_ledger.chain INTEGER, transactions.chain TEXT)
top_10_blockers.impact: Cross-table joins on chain (e.g. positions JOIN transactions ON chain) require explicit cast. Reporting SQL becomes fragile. Schema-vs-design drift.
top_10_blockers.fix_in: P0-PG-02 (decide: all TEXT or all INTEGER; provide migration to align)

top_10_blockers.title: lpbot-shadow.service missing EnvironmentFile=.env.postgres
top_10_blockers.impact: After running apply_postgres_migrations.sh, DATABASE_URL is exported in the shell but NOT in the systemd manager's environment. lpbot-shadow will fail to start with empty DSN.

top_10_blockers.title: TestPostgresAdapter_DockerIntegration_RoundTrip is gated on docker availability AND uses divergent schema
top_10_blockers.impact: The only real Postgres integration test (a) only runs if docker is in PATH (skipped on most CI runners), (b) creates its own ad-hoc schema (CREATE TABLE positions ... last_score JSONB) that does NOT match migrations/postgres/*.sql, (c) does NOT exercise any of the migration files, (d) does NOT cover shadow_decision_trace, shadow_position_marks, shadow_exit_*, portfolio_snapshots, position_marks, canary_events, execution_intents. So migration drift is undetectable by current test suite.

top_10_blockers.title: No migration runner / embed in Go; migrations applied via raw psql in shell script
files: scripts/apply_postgres_migrations.sh (psql -f migrations/postgres/*.sql, no version tracking, no down, no checksum)
internal/adapters/store/postgres/ (no migrate.go, no embed.FS, no goose import)
top_10_blockers.impact: Migration ordering relies on lexical file sort. No atomic apply. No rollback. No checksum. No in-Go version tracking. Re-runs can corrupt (UPDATE transactions SET created_at = ... CASE ... in 000004 is non-idempotent). For shadow this is acceptable; for canary/live this is a blocker.
top_10_blockers.fix_in: P0-PG-02 (add Go-based migration runner + embed.FS + checksum; or at minimum, add ordering check + dry-run report)

top_10_blockers.title: 000004_transactions_timestamp_cleanup is non-idempotent
files: migrations/postgres/000004_transactions_timestamp_cleanup.sql:11-25 (UPDATE transactions SET created_at = CASE WHEN created_at > 0 AND created_at < 2000000000 THEN created_at * 1000 ELSE created_at END)
top_10_blockers.impact: First run converts seconds to milliseconds. Second run is safe (created_at < 2000000000 check). But if a row was inserted with seconds AND multiplied, the second run no-ops. Re-applying migrations during a partial failure is risky.
top_10_blockers.fix_in: P0-PG-02 (add a flag column or idempotency check)

top_10_blockers.title: No -race in CI or Makefile
top_10_blockers.impact: Race conditions in postgres adapter (concurrent UpsertTx, concurrent position status update) are undetectable. Given shadow mode now writes to Postgres, race exposure is higher than sqlite.
top_10_blockers.fix_in: P0-PG-05 (test coverage improvements) or P0-PG-04 (CI migration tests)
